notes.title: Compatibility Update and a Happy New Year!
notes.notes:
What's new? Well, lots and lots of things, invisible, under the hood. One thing that can at least be heard: The bundled hypnosis sessions have been re-recorded by a professional hypnotist now. I hope you like them. Apart from that, I just hope everything works for now and I can start working an an update that will actually can be seen and experienced.
Until then: Enjoy!

notes.title: Mind Massaging Machine Bugfix Release 1.0.4 and SessionMaker Update
notes.notes:
This is a quick update to let you know that version 1.0.4 of MMM has been uploaded to all platforms and should arrive on your devices soon if it hasn't already. This update has minor improvements and also fixes a few more problematic bugs. 

 Fixed Bugs
- Sessions using MP3 files were not working on certain devices
- Sessions that had no audio file or textscript did not run properly 
- corrupted or otherwise not readable sessions could be imported and break SessionLibrary

Also, SessionMaker has been updated to let you set a duration for files that do not use an audio file or a textscript. You can download the updated SessionMaker from here (I'll be including it in Steam soon).

If nothing critical is found the next update should be v1.1 later this month. Wish me luck!
